name: bw_survey
prompt:
A clear BLACK-AND-WHITE flat-vector diagram for a Chinese report, in FOUR horizontal bands read top to bottom. STRICTLY MONOCHROME: only pure black, white and one light gray. No color. LANDSCAPE, wider than tall, about 3:2. Pure white background. Bold crisp Chinese sans-serif typography, generously spaced. Thin precise black rules, no shadows, no gradients. Do NOT draw any overall title or caption.

On the FAR LEFT edge, four small solid BLACK label tabs, one vertically centered on each band, with WHITE Chinese text: 有什么用 / 怎么实现 / 未来 / 怎么建

BAND 1 (top) — three equal WHITE boxes side by side with THICK black outlines. Each has a solid BLACK header strip with LARGE WHITE Chinese text and below it one line of black Chinese text:
Box 1 header 溯源检索 , line 找得到材料 条条有出处
Box 2 header 调研归集 , line 访谈座谈问卷 变成可用证据
Box 3 header 学术助研 , line 看得清缺口 理得出命题

BAND 2 — three WHITE boxes with THIN black outlines, each directly under the box above, each holding three short black Chinese lines with small black square bullets:
Box 1: 建材料库 收五类材料 / 按学科 学段 类型分好 / 每条必填出处
Box 2: 录音转写 纪要结构化 / 问卷编码统计 / 观点归集 分共识与分歧
Box 3: 给材料贴标签 归入八个部分 / 自动数出哪部分材料少 / 政策 学术 史料 调研四栏并排
Draw a THICK BLACK upward arrow from each BAND 2 box into the BAND 1 box above it.

BAND 3 — one narrow full-width box drawn with a DASHED black outline and white fill, containing black Chinese text on one line: 教材评价与合规审查　六个方面质量试标 · 表述比对与风险提示　课题后期启动

BAND 4 (bottom) — a LIGHT GRAY strip spanning the full width containing a left-to-right chain of four WHITE boxes with thin black outlines joined by THICK BLACK right-pointing arrows. Each box has a small black circled number, a bold black Chinese title and one smaller black Chinese line:
Box 1 number 1, title 搭系统 , line 委托技术团队开发 复用校内服务器
Box 2 number 2, title 建材料库 , line 三院师生标注 学生初标 教师确认
Box 3 number 3, title 上功能 , line 六个月核心 一年全部建成
Box 4 number 4, title 交运营 , line 结项后教务处承接
